Ordinary miners from all over the country are given just two weeks military training before being sent the Western Front. Their task is to undermine the German Lines. Stars Brendan Cowell and Harrison Gilbertson.

Directed by Gurinder Chadra and stars Hugh Bonneville, Gillian Anderson and Michael Gambon.
